headline: Violation hearings for Martiza Bar & Grill and Anokye Krom, plus liquor and entertainment license requests.
summary: Two status hearings are also on the agenda, for Creed and for O'Connor's Restaurant & Bar. A lodging house license request from WPI and a withdrawal request from Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant are listed too.
